text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
You know, I really think they're going to
cancel
the BNW concert...

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
What?! But we came all the way here
just to see
them! We can't give up yet!
Come on, let's just
wait a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head over to the mall on my day off to
enjoy
some performances going on
there, but when I
arrive, the crowd
seems worked up in a bad way.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh, trainer sighted! Nice timing!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I bet you're curious about what's going
on too,
right? Let's scramble together
and find out! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun pulls me into the
center of the
chaos, where Biwa
Hayahide is standing with a
worried
expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But if we cancel the concert, everyone
who came
to watch us will be so
disappointed.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I know I can't carry the show by myself,
but
maybe I can buy some time until
Taishin and
Ticket arrive, and—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh gosh, what's wrong, Hayahide? You
look like
you're about to send out a
distress call!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't expecting to see you two here.
I'm sorry
you have to see me in such a
state, but the truth
is...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! Tickezo and Taishin won't
make it?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
They said their train's stopped.
Thankfully, I
decided to come early to
make sure everything
was all right. But
still...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This is supposed to be a BNW concert,
and the
set list was decided with all
three of us in mind.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It's not possible to make it work on my own. Sigh... I can't believe we'll have to cancel everything after all that preparation.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Hayahide? How about if I act as
your
wingman?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it'd be a huge shame to let so
many
people down! Especially on a
weekend!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I wanna do something for them, and they
could
all use a present right now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The word "present" reminds me of when
Mayano
Top Gun gave Oguri Cap a gift.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's a little "just-because" present!
From me to
you!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You almost got it, but nope! This is gonna be a "slightly-special-because-it's-a wonderful-weekend" present!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
My dad gives out more than one kind of
gift, you
know. He has presents for
sunny days and secret
gifts for my mom,
and all sorts of other presents
too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I want to turn this disappointing day into
a
spectacular gift for everyone!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's okay! If you join us, then we'll
have just the
right number of people!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You're a Tracen trainer, aren't you? That
means
you should be able to sing all our
concert
songs! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not exactly jumping for joy at the
prospect of
performing in front of
everyone, but I have no
choice. I steel
myself and step onto the stage.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Right now, Taishin and Ticket are doing
their best
to make it here.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So until they get here, we'll be singing
together,
everyone! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
This is a special present for you all on
this sparkly
and wonderful weekend!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Man, I came here to see BNW... But I
guess this is
better than no concert at
all.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Heehee! ♪ Time to execute a super
cute turn in
time with the music!)

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Mayano Top Gun is so
energetic—she's
adorable!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(These next steps have gotta look light
and airy!
Hehe! Looks like the audience
is starting to get
their jets burning!)

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Dang, her moves are awesome! Look how
cool she
is!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that? She just glanced this
way! My
heart actually skipped a beat!
How is she so sweet
and hypnotic at the
same time?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(Mayano is incredible. Even in concerts,
she's
such a free spirit. I can't lose out to
her here!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We're treating you to a one-of-a-kind

arrangement today! So don't even think
about
blinking!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: As a treat, I'll give you all a glimpse of both my cute side and my cool side! ♪

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
That Mayano Top Gun is really
something else... I
should go watch her
next race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... Hey, everyone's having a blast.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! They're doing great! We can't let
them
beat us though! C'mon, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You two made it! We've got a full squadron now! Okay, let's really get this party going! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
BNW's joint performance with Mayano
Top Gun is
a smashing success and ends
up becoming the top
trending topic on
social media.
